title: Мигрировать consumers и закрыть cross-language bypass gate
summary: Перевести repository consumers на safe facade и выпустить проверяемый P2 receipt, что supported call graph и PHP/Dart behavior больше не обходят trusted boundary.
why: Наличие safe service не устраняет bypass, пока reference coordinator, examples или top-level imports продолжают учить прямому `ConfirmationProtocol::commit`; одновременно P7, а не P2, владеет окончательным export removal. `RAG:—`.

include: PHP reference slice composition/migration; constructor wiring through trusted adapters; package-level layer-boundary checks; exact allowlist прямых legacy usages; PHP/Dart adversarial parity report; migration/deprecation evidence for P7; full package regression.
exclude: Production identity/policy/storage adapters; physical package split; deleting legacy protocol/export; new spec revision; P3 durable consume; P5 audit/event work; public documentation/release.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: Reference composition injects trusted adapters once and invokes only `ConfirmationService` for prepare/commit. Validator scans production/reference/package examples and permits direct low-level calls only in the two focused protocol implementation/test boundaries named in its versioned allowlist; an unknown new call is RED. It reports exports separately: P2 may add/deprecate but may not remove PHP PSR-4/Dart barrel compatibility. Parity receipt derives exact case/result/code sets from real test outputs, not prose, and names P3/P5/P6/P7 deferred owners. No safe result claims durable one-shot until P3 evidence exists.
guidance: Keep trusted test adapters local to reference/test namespaces; no allow-all production authorizer. Map authenticated actor/tenant/resource from bound reference port state, not constants passed per invocation. Validator is stdlib-only, deterministic, path-rooted, and outputs machine-readable JSON plus concise human summary. Report raw tokens, subject identifiers and policy internals only as redacted digests/counts.

sections.text: `python3 tools/validate_confirmation_boundary.py --check`; its negative self-probe in a temporary copied file catches each forbidden parameter/direct call without touching repository files; `cd php && composer test && composer analyse`; `cd dart/agentools && dart analyze && dart test`; shared manifest parity yields identical passed/denied semantic sets and `missing=[]`, `extra=[]`, `mismatch=[]`; reference slice negative tests cover caller `dualControl=false`, null proposer, permissive authorizer, stale time/descriptor, actor spoof, policy/approval mismatch and revoked authorization; frozen spec delta empty; plan lint adds no ERROR.
